name: Morrosaurus
sum: An elasmarian ornithopod of about 4.5 to 5 m from the Maastrichtian Snow Hill Island Formation of Antarctica.
wsnote: Estimated from the only specimen, an adult, at 4.5 to 5 m (English Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: MACN Pv 197, a partial skeleton from Cape Lamb, Snow Hill Island Formation, Antarctica.
biology: Larger and more robust than the other Antarctic ornithopod Trinisaura; the fragmentary material says little more.
author: Rozadilla et al. 2016

sources.text: S. Rozadilla, F. L. Agnolin, and F. E. Novas, A. M. Aranciaga Rolando, M. J. Motta, J. M. Lirio, M. P. Isasi. 2016. A new ornithopod (Dinosauria, Ornithischia) from the Upper Cretaceous of Antarctica and its palaeobiogeographical implications. Cretaceous Research 57:311-324
